title: Color Forcing
wikitext:
=== Standard Color Forcing ===

This is represented by "enemycolor" and "teamcolor" settings in [[ezQuake]] and [[FuhQuake]] clients. Those allow you to use one skin for all enemies and onther single skin for all teammates.

=== Special Color Forcing ===

Color Forcing is also a name for the feature that allows you to set different color (or skin) on different players in the game, making the players distinguishable from each other even if their personal "skin" and "color" settings are equal.

This feature is available in [[Qizmo]] and [[ezQuake]]. It's controlled by [[FPD]].

* [http://ezquake.sourceforge.net/docs/?player-skins#teammates ezQuake Color Forcing]
